title: SafeTeleport accepts a pre-death binding for a replacement Hero life
status: Implemented/statically validated and independently reviewed on verified main d3c2dd2d. Original native stale-life movement is preserved; repaired native death/respawn acceptance remains pending.
severity: Major lifecycle/state safety: an obsolete action can move the replacement Hero after death. Demonstrated64-unit in-cell relocation; no unobserved progression bypass, card loss or broader corruption is claimed.

baseline.identity_evidence: ../floor-support/native-repaired/prepared-provenance.json and source-{server,client}-proof.json; same continuously running fresh source15 native client.

environment.hardware: Actual Valve Jupiter Steam Deck / AMD Custom APU0405
environment.client: Windows x86 Garry's Mod under Proton, LuaJIT2.0.4/engine2026.09.17
environment.qualification: Developer diagnostic capture, console kill and bounded canonical relocation on an isolated private profile. Earlier ordinary character selection/deployment and natural combat are separate evidence; this is not an ordinary campaign pass.

reproduction: In the source15 actual native private client, capture LIFET.b=SafeTeleport:Bind(currentHero) while lives2. Confirm Matches=true and both b.life and ps.equipmentLifeSerial printnil.

Use the native console kill to exercise actual death and respawn lifecycle. The Hero loses a life2->1. An earlyF opens the existing Tetris death minigame while WAIT14 is still mandatory; this is not an early respawn.
Wait through the mandatory gate and respawn: Hero aliveHP100/lives1, same player-state table0xc2ed89aa, LODRunSpawnSerial6. The old binding still returns Matches=true.
First attempt canonical MoveBound with old binding to the +X64 candidate. Geometry rejects and no move occurs; preserve as a rejected geometry control, not successful stale movement.
Choose a landing-approved point through canonical Landing; the safe probe selectsY-64. The same obsolete binding returns MoveBound=true and actually moves the replacement Hero fromY-2688 toY-2752.
Capture a fresh binding and restore through canonical MoveBound; fresh restore succeeds.
expected: Once that Hero life dies and is replaced, the old binding must no longer match or commit movement. A fresh current-life binding must retain ordinary safe landing/movement and all existing geometry/run/graph/seed/role checks.

initial_unsafe_X.qualification: This first geometry-rejected attempt alone does not demonstrate stale movement. It remains explicit negative evidence beside the successful safe-Y probe.

cause: Bind records the absent ps.equipmentLifeSerial. Matches compares the absent current field to that savednil while the same player entity/state, run, graph and seed survive native respawn. Their equality admits a replacement body life. The canonical advancing LODRunSpawnSerial is not captured or compared.

repair.meaningful_regression: Existing Warp Hole suite invokes the actual production PlayerSpawn hook while retaining the Hero state and nil legacy field, then reject stale Matches/MoveBound and permit fresh canonical Landing/move/restore. This avoids inventing a synthetic equipmentLifeSerial increment.
repair.implementation: Shared Bind/Matches repair now captures and compares the actual canonical player-body spawn marker while preserving old player-state/equipment-life/run/graph/seed guards. No floor-support, collision, damage, difficulty or GDD changes.
